item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 27/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will affect Guangdong tomorrow. It will be rather cool in the morning over the region. A fresh to strong easterly airstream is expected to affect southern China early next week. Meanwhile, an upper-air disturbance will bring rainy weather to the region. With the easterly airstream moderating, it will become warm, humid and brighter over the coastal areas gradually in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, a trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to Guangdong over the weekend next week.
